page.overview:
What is Gotham City Police Department?

The GCPD is the municipal police force of Gotham City.

The GCPD would normally deal with typical cases of murder, robbery rackets and would usually solve them under the guidance of James Gordon, sometimes with unrequired help from the vigilante Batman.

Often, the GCPD found Batman at the crime scene and started investigating him as the principal suspect. However, Batman would always solve the case and bring the real criminals to justice.

The GCPD was soon baffled by the appearance of new super-criminals like the Joker, Two-Face, Catwoman, Penguin and Hugo Strange among many others and most times, Batman would stop their plans and capture the villains, much to the GCPD's frustration.

Also known as: GCPD, Gotham PD.
